dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: Q3 26 revenue guided to $1.70-1.74B (+13% to +15% YoY vs $1.507B in Q3 25; deceleration vs +19% in Q2 reflects World Cup spend normalization and tougher comps after the ad platform stabilized in late Q2 25); adjusted EBITDA guided to $300-350M, with restructuring personnel savings more fully reflected from Q3 onward.
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY26 infrastructure costs raised to $1.65-1.70B (from $1.60-1.65B) for incremental AI/ML capacity supporting revenue growth (framed as optional flexibility, not committed spend); other cost of revenue kept at 16-17% of revenue; FY adjusted opex ~$2.75B and SBC ~$1.05B; after the current buyback completes in Q4, a new multi-year dilution-management program funded primarily by FCF targets a stable fully diluted share count in 2027; management reiterates sustained positive GAAP net income beginning in 2027.
pointsCles: Q2 26 revenue of $1.60B (+19% YoY, ~ $66M above consensus): advertising +9% to $1.28B and other revenue +85% to $316M (Snapchat+, Memory Storage, Lens+; <3% of 971M MAUs are paying subscribers). Adjusted EBITDA of $250M (vs $41M a year ago), gross margin 58% (+7pts), FCF $121M — 8th consecutive positive-FCF quarter; free cash flow per share is now management's primary financial objective.

April 2026 restructuring (~1,000 roles, -16% of headcount, $128.5M of Q2 charges) already visible: total adjusted costs grew only +4% YoY against +19% revenue growth; AI-driven internal leverage (code commits per engineer +75%, AI reviewing 90% of pull requests, support ticket volume -62% since January).

Direct-response engine is driving the ad recovery: total conversions +56% YoY, cost per install -8%, cost per purchase -18%, app purchase volume +128%, dynamic product ads revenue +43%; sponsored Snaps reach ~1/3 incremental; World Cup brand spend helped Q2 and normalizes in Q3 (guide implies +13-15% growth vs +19% delivered).

Specs commercial launch this fall (September 16 LA event, $2,195 price point, pre-orders open ~7 weeks): investment kept inside the existing opex envelope and paced on product/ecosystem/economic milestones; mass-market adoption not expected before end of decade; no comment on a Specs spin-off; several US trials and youth-safety regulatory scrutiny flagged for H2 2026.

hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
A measurable operating turnaround: Q2 26 showed revenue +19% against adjusted costs +4%, the direct result of the April 2026 restructuring (~1,000 roles, >500M annualized savings targeted in H2). The bet is NOT a miraculous ad acceleration (already solid via AI tools - Smart Campaigns, conversions +56%) but the cost discipline converting existing growth into a first full year of positive net income in 2027. Infrastructure-cost guidance was still RAISED (1.65-1.70bn) - the AI compute bill grows even under discipline.

== THESIS READ ==
- The 2026 -> 2027 sign flip (EPS -0.09 -> +0.18) is the entire thesis; every quarter of cost discipline is evidence. Watch: H2 opex prints vs the >500M savings target.
- Restructuring is treated as a RECURRING cost in disguise (quasi-annual since IPO: 2019 legal, 2022, 2026) - deliberately NOT retreated; the model is honest about it. Watch: whether 2027 passes without another one.
- Infrastructure inflation is the counterweight: raised guidance shows AI compute eats savings. Watch: infra cost per DAU trajectory.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Base = published GAAP, restructuring kept in (ancrage restructuration_recurrente). Financial result: recent near-zero quarterly rhythm retained over the normative Treasury formula (low-coupon convertibles - ancrage fin_result_snap). Tax: low effective rising gradually (NOL carryforwards), 10% -> 16% across the plan. Loss-year bridge documented.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue 6,818M (+15%), EBIT -140M (last loss year modeled), EPS -0.09; 2027-2030: revenue +11-14%/yr, EBIT margin 4% -> 10.5%, shares -1.2%/yr. Watch: DAU/engagement stability through the cost cuts; ad-pricing recovery; NOL utilization pace as profits arrive.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 (Oct) - first full savings quarter; 2027 profitability inflection; Smart Campaign adoption metrics; any restructuring recurrence (negative).

ancrages.moteur: Advertising growth recovery driven by AI tools (Smart Campaign, conversions +56%) and the ramp-up of Other revenue (Snapchat+, Lens+, Memories), which now accounts for 20% of revenue and is growing at 85%
Gradual slowdown expected in advertising growth as the comparison base grows, with Specs becoming the main unquantified incremental catalyst beyond 2027

April 2026 restructuring (more than 500 M$ of annualised savings, fully reflected from Q3 26 and therefore on a full-year basis from 2027) and operating leverage already observed (revenue +19% vs adjusted costs +4% in Q2 26)

The restructuring charges (2019: 100 M$; 2022: 189 M$; 2026: 128,5 M$ in H1) occurring at regular intervals since the IPO are treated as a disguised-recurring component of operating cost, neither adjusted out in data nor excluded from adjXXX

Financial charges/income projected on the basis of the recent quarterly net run-rate (close to breakeven, convertible bonds with a very low 0-0,75% coupon issued 2019-2023) rather than the normative 10-year Treasury +2pts rule
Effective tax rate kept low and rising gradually on the back of the large net operating loss carryforwards (NOL) accumulated since the stock market listing in 2017
New multi-year dilution management programme funded by free cash flow from 2027, after completion of the current buyback programme in Q4 2026
